home.title: Velmar Technology MSP Services
home.tagline: Enterprise Managed IT Support, Helpdesk Ticketing, Device Monitoring & Cloud Invoicing Platform
home.purposeTitle: What is Velmar Technology MSP Services?
home.purposeDescription: Velmar Technology MSP Services is an enterprise-grade Managed Service Provider (MSP) software platform engineered to deliver end-to-end technical helpdesk support, automated 1-hour SLA escalation tracking, RMM infrastructure monitoring, device telemetry, subscription management, recurring billing, and virtual CIO (vCIO) account health analytics.
home.featuresSubtitle: Integrated enterprise workflows built for proactive IT operations and client transparency
home.feature1Desc: Multi-tier ticket routing, automated 1-hour SLA enforcement for warranty and outage events, capacity-weighted technician dispatch, and response history.
home.feature2Desc: Real-time workstation and server monitoring, 15-minute alert deduplication, automated script self-healing (<300s), and security patch advisory management.
home.feature3Desc: Flexible MSP service tiers, automated recurring invoice generation, PayPal REST order capture, wire transfer reconciliation, and seat true-up scaling.
home.feature4Desc: Composite health scoring combining ticket performance, hardware age, and security posture with automated Quarterly Business Review (QBR) triggers.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to Streamline Your IT Infrastructure?
home.ctaSubtitle: Access your portal to submit support requests, monitor active devices, or manage subscription plans.
